name: Outcome Router
job: Central router. Reads opportunity.sale_outcome_v2 and appt_status from Force writes (see to-be/force.json) and routes to the correct downstream workflow. WF-05 never writes any Force field, never creates an opportunity, and never moves opportunity stages. Never fires on MAR. Still ADD-TO-WF WF-13 on SOLD + sale_type=new (recorded truth in GHL; site cards hide WF-13).

trigger.notes: Trigger id ryJLJ1McWWOHlAvBRsI3. GHL shell name is null. Webhook URL is UI-only; paste it into Force config as GHL_WF05_WEBHOOK_URL. Payload includes contact_id, sale_outcome, sale_type, appt_status, ad_reason.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Inbound webhook GHL_WF05_WEBHOOK_URL
named_steps.comment: Force writes enter here only (see to-be/force.json). WF-05 never writes Force fields (sale_outcome, sale_type, appt_status, monetaryValue, pay_type, ad_reason), never creates an opp, and never moves stages. Must not accept payloads with sale_outcome=MAR (guarded below).

named_steps.name: WAIT: 60s so opp writes settle
named_steps.comment: Allows the upstream Force write to land on the opportunity before FIND-OPP reads it.

named_steps.name: FIND-OPP: Latest open opp for contact
named_steps.comment: Native find opp. Must not create a new opp here (WF-01 create-once is the sole creator). Must not read monetaryValue for logic and must not write any Force field.

named_steps.name: IF: appt_status = no-show
named_steps.comment: Route no-show first, before outcome routing.

named_steps.name: PATH: no-show
named_steps.comment: True branch of the no-show guard.

named_steps.name: PATH: not no-show
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through; next appt_status IF still evaluates.

named_steps.name: IF: appt_status = cancel
named_steps.comment: Cancel also routes to WF-08.

named_steps.name: PATH: cancel
named_steps.comment: True branch of the cancel guard.

named_steps.name: PATH: not cancel
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through.

named_steps.name: IF: appt_status = reschedule
named_steps.comment: Reschedule re-enters reminders via WF-03. Must never be treated as no-show.

named_steps.name: PATH: reschedule
named_steps.comment: True branch of the reschedule guard.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route reschedule to WF-03 Reminders
named_steps.comment: ADD-TO-WF WF-03 ec08cae5-3d1f-48bd-9a0d-444626d9a150.

named_steps.name: PATH: not reschedule
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through; outcome routing begins.

named_steps.name: IF: sale_outcome_v2 = MAR (head guard)
named_steps.comment: MAR payloads never enter outcome routing. Guard branch exits the workflow.

named_steps.name: PATH: MAR (exit)
named_steps.comment: Drop path. MAR contacts do not enroll in any downstream WF.

named_steps.name: PATH: not MAR
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through into outcome routing.

named_steps.name: IF: sale_outcome_v2 = SOLD
named_steps.comment: Routes downstream. Must not write dollars. Must not move opp stages.

named_steps.name: PATH: SOLD
named_steps.comment: True branch. Tag and sub-branch on sale_type.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_outcome_sold (SOLD branch)
named_steps.comment: Tags outcome only. Must not stage-move.

named_steps.name: IF: sale_type = new
named_steps.comment: SOLD splits into onboarding (new) vs renewal-nurture.

named_steps.name: PATH: new
named_steps.comment: True branch: SOLD + new.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route SOLD new to WF-06 Onboarding
named_steps.comment: ADD-TO-WF WF-06 5d036b8a-4336-47c8-9ebe-77f3439bc95c. Onboarding owns membership_status writes; must not set it here.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route SOLD new to WF-13 (GHL current)
named_steps.comment: ADD-TO-WF WF-13 9513a9c7-69c5-4f1c-9193-b371ab8d8253. Recorded truth in GHL: the router still enrolls WF-13 on SOLD + new. The v2 site card grid hides WF-13 (dropped_from_v2), but the router node exists in the shell.

named_steps.name: PATH: not new (renewal)
named_steps.comment: False branch: SOLD + renewal / unset.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route SOLD renewal to WF-09 Nurture
named_steps.comment: ADD-TO-WF WF-09 cbc14e90-4507-42cd-afcc-f7410d7f4554. WF-09 owns renewal_date trigger.

named_steps.name: PATH: not SOLD
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through; next outcome IF still evaluates.

named_steps.name: IF: sale_outcome_v2 = AD
named_steps.comment: A&D routing.

named_steps.name: PATH: AD
named_steps.comment: True branch.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_outcome_ad (AD branch)
named_steps.comment: Tags outcome only.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route AD to WF-07 A&D
PATH: not AD
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through.

named_steps.name: IF: sale_outcome_v2 = MUT
named_steps.comment: MUT routing; WF-11 has a MUT front-gate that suppresses the STOP-confirm path for MUT.

named_steps.name: PATH: MUT
named_steps.comment: True branch.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_outcome_mut (MUT branch)
named_steps.comment: Tags outcome only.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route MUT to WF-11 Compliance
named_steps.comment: ADD-TO-WF WF-11 9aab45f8-6f5b-467a-9f05-6981446c48f2. WF-11 front-gate on sale_outcome_v2=MUT prevents the STOP-confirm SMS and the opted_out write.

named_steps.name: PATH: not MUT
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through.

named_steps.name: IF: sale_outcome_v2 = MAR (tail drop guard)
named_steps.comment: Redundant tail guard so a MAR payload that slipped past the head guard still drops without enrolling downstream WFs.

named_steps.name: PATH: MAR (drop)
named_steps.comment: Tail drop.

named_steps.name: PATH: outcome unmatched
named_steps.comment: Fall-through for outcome values not in {SOLD, AD, MUT, MAR}. Router does not enroll a downstream WF.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_router_dropped (audit)
named_steps.comment: Audit tag on unmatched outcomes. Not authored yet; recorded here as router truth.

named_steps.name: IF: sale_type = renewal (audit branch)
named_steps.comment: Router-side renewal audit.

named_steps.name: PATH: renewal
named_steps.comment: True branch.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_sale_renewal (audit)
named_steps.comment: Audit tag for renewal transactions.

named_steps.name: PATH: not renewal
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through.

named_steps.name: WAIT: 1s router settle
named_steps.comment: Final settle before audit tag.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_router_seen (audit)
named_steps.comment: Audit tag on every WF-05 completion (Force write handled).
